title: The Most Magnetic Object in the Universe: Magnetar #Shorts
description:
A magnetar is a dead star crushed to 20 km wide with a magnetic field up to a quadrillion times stronger than Earth's. One starquake in 2004 released in 0.1 seconds the energy our Sun makes in 100,000 years.
